digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and RUF rule enforcement
propositions: Enable RUF rule family in Ruff configuration and remediate all 179 baseline actionable RUF diagnostics (RUF059, RUF022, RUF012, RUF005, RUF043, RUF023, RUF007, RUF028, RUF034, RUF019, RUF046, RUF102).
Add [tool.ruff.lint].ignore = [RUF001, RUF002, RUF003] to defer Unicode-related rules for intentional prose/UI content.
Extend tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert RUF is in select, exactly three rules in ignore, no extend-ignore key, and no RUF per-file-ignores entries.
Remove stale RUF100 noqa suppressions (374 found) under the full configured rule set; do not use narrow-selection RUF100 artifact count to drive removals.
Verify baseline narrow-census command exits 0 and make lint exits 0 against current origin/main after remediation.
